author: Michael Larabel
description: A few days ago Google engineers went public with Sashiko with their agentic AI code review for the Linux kernel. The Google Gemini Pro powered AI code review service is automatically monitoring the Linux kernel mailing list for new patch submissions and has proven useful already. Interest continues to build by upstream Linux kernel stakeholders around Sashiko and the latest addition is now covering the Rust-For-Linux mailing list submissions...
title: Sashiko Now Providing AI Reviews On Rust Code For The Linux Kernel

author: Michael Larabel
description: A Linux HID driver is being developed for Pulsar branded gaming mice to expose additional information and capabilities...
title: Linux Driver Being Worked On For Pulsar Gaming Mice

author: Michael Larabel
description: LibreOffice 26.8 merged initial support for adding a donation banner to its Start Center. This initial UI when launching LibreOffice aims to make users aware of the community-driven focus of the project and to hopefully solicit additional donations from the community...
title: LibreOffice 26.8 To Add A Donation Banner To Its Start Center

author: Michael Larabel
description: Merged overnight for Linux 7.0 and set to be back-ported to existing Linux stable kernel versions is a fix for aging AMD GCN 1.0 "Hainan" GPU models. This closes a 2021 bug report that was long neglected and ended up being just a small tweak to fix the issue reported of GPU hangs...
title: Linux 7.0 Lands Fix For Years Old Bug Affecting AMD Hainan GPUs

author: Michael Larabel
description: For any holdouts still running SysV Init instead of systemd or other alternatives like OpenRC, SysV Init 3.16 is out as the first release in a half-year and bringing a few refinements...
title: SysV Init 3.16 Released With Cleanups, Improved systemd Unit To SysV Script Conversion
